summary: Done: recorded the final bounded Lean Dispatch multi-WORK smoke test. PLAN opened alpha WORK task 01a061ef-080d-7842-895b-81e553d2a522 and beta WORK task 01a061ef-12a4-7612-8461-e3bf381e1ec4 under dispatch-final-lean-multi-work-smoke-2026-09-02-01 with parallelLimit 2. Alpha returned PASS automatically to PLAN. Beta returned an intentional RISK needs-revision probe, PLAN sent Revision Packet revision-final-lean-beta-revision-smoke-2026-09-02-01 back to the same beta task, and beta returned a revised PASS handoff. The result proves only local projectless no-edit Lean Dispatch automatic return, completionQueue handling, and same-room revision loop behavior.
